title: Intel Corporation second-quarter 2026 financial results
excerpt: Q2 revenue was $16.1 billion, GAAP gross margin 40.4%, non-GAAP EPS $0.42, and Q3 revenue guidance $15.8-$16.8 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release supports current revenue, product and foundry trends, margins, normalized earnings, cash flow, investment requirements, and third-quarter guidance.
